newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil seeks 60 bln reais for states' refinancing.
newsitem.headline: Brazil seeks 60 bln reais for states' refinancing.

text.p: The Brazilian government will ask Congress to approve a budget supplement of about 60 billion reais to fund refinancing programmes for the states, the Folha de Sao Paulo newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Quoting Finance Ministry executive secretary Pedro Parente, Folha said the funds would be raised through federal securities.
Neither Parente nor other Finance Ministry officials were immediately available for comment.
Parente told Folha the extra funds did not represent additional public sector debt because Brasilia was merely exchanging high-cost state debt for cheaper federal debt.
He said the total amount needed for debt renegotiations with the states had still to be determined but added that Sao Paulo state alone could require 36 billion reais in refinancing.

Brazil last year carried out extensive negotiations with several states to renegotiate their debts with the Treasury, swapping short-term high interest rate paper for longer maturities and lower costs.
